canonical_owner_decision_register.governance_notice: This register reflects current institutional auditor recommendations. It does NOT constitute human owner approval.

decisions.title: Market Data Provider Selection
decisions.description: Select primary market-data vendor. Tiingo Power (/mo) is recommended for daily EOD bar research; Alpaca AlgoTrader Plus (/mo) is recommended for paper order execution. Offline historical testing is permitted without live data feeds.

decisions.title: Market Data Licensing and Rights
decisions.description: Contractual non-display usage, derived works storage, and post-termination purge rules remain unapproved. Offline protocol design permitted; forward data ingestion strictly BLOCKED.

decisions.title: Statistical Endpoint and Inferential Protocol
decisions.description: Confirmatory superiority is REJECTED due to small-sample size distortion (7.7% - 10.8% rejection at null). Option C (Exploratory Prospective Comparison) is recommended as the baseline protocol.

decisions.title: Evaluation Horizon and Stopping Rules
decisions.description: Inverse sampling quota design (minimum N_def >= 30, baseline 252 sessions, maximum 504 sessions). Requires human owner signature.

decisions.title: Monitoring and Incident Governance
decisions.description: Tripwire thresholds specified (slippage > 50 bps, 3 missing bars). Physical network latency profiling remains blocked until live feed access is approved.

decisions.title: Activation Authority
decisions.description: Permanent safety barrier. Zero autonomous agent activation authority. Prospective paper and live trading remain strictly unauthorized.
